drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s identity and confidential regulatory matter must not be disclosed. The draft is materially incomplete, so the revisions add a workable payment mechanism, define the release, and make confidentiality subject to customary legal and professional disclosures. The amount remains a negotiation placeholder rather than an invented figure.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached are targeted revisions to make the agreement operational while preserving the core settlement terms. Please provide your proposed settlement amount and any payment-timing requirements so we can complete the draft promptly. We have also clarified the release and added customary exceptions to confidentiality for legally required and professional disclosures.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount of $[Settlement Amount] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall provide any reasonably necessary payment instructions promptly. Each party shall bear its own fees and costs except as expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff, for itself and its successors and assigns, fully and forever releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, and each of their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff asserted or could have asserted arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement through the Effective Date. This release does not apply to obligations created by this Agreement. Plaintiff represents that it has authority to grant this release.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the existence and terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by duties of confidentiality; as reasonably necessary to enforce or perform this Agreement; or as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate, at the other party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment provided for herein are a compromise of disputed claims and do not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either party. Neither this Agreement nor its terms may be offered as evidence except as necessary to enforce or perform it or as otherwise required by law.
edits.name: No Admission
